title: Chemical formulas
competency: Write formulas of elements and compounds and explain what a molecule is.

keywords.def: The symbolic representation of an element or a compound, like H₂O.
The smallest particle of an element or compound that has a stable, independent existence.
A molecule made of two atoms, like H₂ or O₂.
The small number after a symbol. In H₂O the 2 is a subscript.

en.text: A chemical formula is the symbolic representation of an element or a compound. Noble gases like helium exist as single atoms, so their formula is their symbol: He. Hydrogen, nitrogen, oxygen, fluorine, chlorine, bromine and iodine exist as diatomic molecules: H₂, N₂, O₂, F₂, Cl₂, Br₂, I₂. Ozone is O₃, phosphorus P₄ and sulfur S₈.

screens.title: The oxygen we breathe
screens.ask: The oxygen we breathe: single O atoms, or two O atoms joined?
screens.after: Oxygen gas is made of molecules of two atoms: O₂.

screens.title: 3.2.2 Chemical formulas
paras: A chemical formula is the symbolic representation of an element or a compound.
There are formulas of elements and formulas of compounds.
The formula of an element has one kind of symbol.

screens.title: Molecules
paras: A molecule is the smallest particle of an element or compound that has a stable, independent existence.
Helium, neon, argon, krypton, xenon and radon are noble gases.
They exist as single atoms (monoatomic). Their formula is the same as their symbol: He, Ne, Ar.

screens.title: Table 3.3: Diatomic elements
paras: Some non-metals exist as molecules of two atoms. They are diatomic molecules.
screens.note: Some molecules have more than two atoms: ozone O₃, phosphorus P₄, sulfur S₈.

screens.text: Tap every element whose formula is the SAME as its symbol.
screens.why: Noble gases (He, Ar, Ne) exist as single atoms. H, Br and O are diatomic: H₂, Br₂, O₂.

en.text: A chemical formula with two or more different symbols stands for a compound. The small number after each symbol, the subscript, tells how many atoms of that element there are. In H₂O there are two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom.

screens.title: The small 2
screens.ask: In H₂O, what does the small 2 tell you?
screens.after: The 2 belongs to H. There are two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom.

screens.title: Formulas of compounds
paras: A formula of a compound has two or more different symbols.
Each symbol is followed by a subscript. It shows the number of atoms of that element.

screens.title: Reading H₂O
steps: H₂: the subscript 2 means 2 hydrogen atoms.
O: no subscript, so 1 oxygen atom.
So one water molecule has 2 H atoms and 1 O atom.
